نصهاب (form XI)
# نَصْهَابُّ (naṣhābbu) /nasˤ.haːb.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْهَابَّ (iṣhābba)
# نَصْهَابَّ (naṣhābba) /nasˤ.haːb.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْهَابَّ (iṣhābba)
# نَصْهَابِّ (naṣhābbi) /nasˤ.haːb.bi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِصْهَابَّ (iṣhābba)
